title: Xanthe and the Alibi
author: Gideon Ashgrove
blurb: Felix Hartwell, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the tide gives up what it took.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
